@runtime_checkable
class IDisassembleSummaryFormatter(Protocol):
    '''
        Structural interface protocol for formatting binary disassembly summaries.

        It defines:

            :methods:
                | format_summary - Formats DisassemblySummary into human-readable CLI report.
                | get_version - Returns the interface protocol version identifier.
    '''
